failure_summary.description: A numeric page value was emitted as a JSON number rather than a string.
A source selector used display-name casing instead of the canonical lowercase value expected by the endpoint.
A schema-optional country filter was placed in the required-parameters list.
The headlines call omitted optional language and page-size fields expected by the evaluator.

patch.reasoning: The observed errors are already directly covered by the skill: scalar values must be strings, selectors should use documented canonical tokens, and schema-optional fields belong in the optional list. The omitted fields are not both clearly required by the query or documented defaults, so adding a rule to supply them would risk encouraging unsupported values. No patch is warranted.
